excelStructure.description: Excel has nested structure where timeline entries follow the main case row

employee_cases.report_date: DATE (from Excel: first Timeline Kasus date)

mappingRules.reportDate: Parse from first timeline date or use year
mappingRules.employeeId: Lookup from employees table by name, or create manual entry
mappingRules.employeeNip: Lookup from employees table, or use placeholder

challenges: Employee names in Excel may not match exactly with employees table
NIP not provided in Excel - need to lookup or use placeholder
Timeline dates are in various formats (need parsing)
Some timeline dates are just year (2017) without specific date
Unit Kerja names may not match work_units table exactly
Need to handle cases where employee not found in database
recommendations: Create manual employee entries for cases where employee not found
Use fuzzy matching for employee names
Parse timeline dates carefully with fallback to year-01-01
Store original Excel data in case_details for reference
Mark imported cases with a flag in case_details
Create import log to track success/failures
